[by Claude Code]

## Motivation

Fixes #43997 on the v0.5.21 release line.

On v0.5.21, GLM-5.3-Flash with `--enable-hierarchical-cache` returns wrong output whenever a prefix is restored from the host tier. The hybrid KDA + DSA host stack (`_MambaStrategy`) backs up the MLA KV and the KDA state but not the DSA indexer keys, so a restored prefix selects its sparse top-k from the keys of whichever request last owned those device pages. A verbatim-recall probe on 4x B300 (TP4, the GLM-5.3-Flash recipe flags) gets 18 of 20 host restores wrong, while all cold requests and device-pool hits are correct.

`main` already fixed this through #40913 and #40915, which assemble `_MambaStrategy` from `host_pool_decls()` and so pick up the DSA indexer pool. Those PRs are part of a ~1.7k-line host-pool declaration refactor that does not apply to v0.5.21. This PR backports only the behavior, using the same `DSAIndexerPoolHost` sidecar that v0.5.21's pure-DSA stack (`_DsaStrategy`) already attaches. It is not needed on `main`.

## Modifications

- `build_hybrid_mamba_stack`: when the full-attention pool is a `DSATokenToKVPool`, add an `INDEXER` entry backed by `DSAIndexerPoolHost`. The entry uses the KV layer mapping and transfer span, like the pure-DSA stack.
- `_MambaStrategy`: register `SidecarPoolSpec(INDEXER, KV)` when that entry exists, so backup and load-back move the index pages together with their KV pages. The boot line then reads `pools=KV + MAMBA + INDEXER`.
- In this release, `DSAIndexerPoolHost` packs one index buffer per target layer and per MTP draft pool. If any layer or draft pool shares top-k (no index keys), the stack keeps the old `KV + MAMBA` behavior and logs a warning, rather than building a misaligned mirror. GLM-5.3-Flash without speculative decoding has no shared-top-k layers.
- Unit tests in `test_hybrid_pool_assembler.py`:
  - a regression case, which fails on the unpatched release: the `INDEXER` entry rides the KV transfers and its sidecar is registered;
  - the shared-top-k skip case.

## Accuracy Tests

4x B300, TP4, `zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash` (FP8, rev `04c4e9e`), `--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --dsa-prefill-backend trtllm --dsa-decode-backend trtllm --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_trtllm --max-total-tokens 49152 --enable-hierarchical-cache --hicache-ratio 2 --mamba-full-memory-ratio 0.2`, no speculative decoding. The probe and full command are in #43997. Each run is one fresh server launch with 10 cold requests, 10 device hits, and 10 host restores; every host restore is a genuine full-prefix L2->L1 load (`load_back_duration_seconds_count` = 10, `load_back_tokens_total{pool="kv"}` = 37,760 = 10 x 3,776, no dropped host tokens).

| build | radix tree core | host pools | cold wrong | device-hit wrong | **host-hit wrong** |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| v0.5.21 image | Rust (default) | `KV + MAMBA` | 0/20 | 0/20 | **18/20** |
| v0.5.21 code | Python | `KV + MAMBA` | 0/10 | 0/10 | **10/10** |
| **this PR** | Rust | `KV + MAMBA + INDEXER` | 0/20 | 0/20 | **0/20** |
| earlier revision of this PR (same behavior for this configuration) | Python | `KV + MAMBA + INDEXER` | 0/20 | 0/20 | **0/20** |
| `main` @ `7224fce1b5` (`dev-cu13` image) | Rust | `KV + INDEXER + MAMBA` | 0/20 | 0/20 | **0/20** |

The "this PR" rows ran the v0.5.21 image with this branch's `python/` overlaid; the image's prebuilt Rust extensions were copied into the overlay so the default Rust tree core loads.

Unit tests, CPU:

```
python -m pytest test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_hybrid_pool_assembler.py
```

The two new cases pass with this change. The regression case fails on unpatched `release/v0.5.21`. The other cases match the base branch.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No speed benchmark. The cost is the indexer mirror on the host, 0.14 GB per rank for the 98,368-token host tier above, plus the index pages copied alongside each KV page on backup and load-back.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (Not applicable.)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Related, not included: #38217 (on `main`) makes `HybridLinearKVPool.get_mla_kv_buffer` wait for the layer load-back. v0.5.21 lacks it, which leaves a narrow window on the same restore path (MHA one-shot prefix read with no full pooled index group in the extend). It did not trigger in this probe.

@@ -1222,6 +1241,27 @@ def build_hybrid_mamba_stack(
     return host_pool_group, cache_controller
 
 
+def _mirrors_hybrid_dsa_indexer(kv_pool: Any, draft_pools: tuple[Any, ...]) -> bool:
+    from sglang.srt.mem_cache.memory_pool import DSATokenToKVPool
+
+    if not isinstance(kv_pool, DSATokenToKVPool):
+        return False
+    # DSAIndexerPoolHost packs one index buffer per target layer and per draft
+    # pool, so every layer of every pool must own index keys.
+    pools = (kv_pool, *draft_pools)
+    if all(
+        isinstance(pool, DSATokenToKVPool) and not any(pool.skip_topk_layers)
+        for pool in pools
+    ):
+        return True
+    logger.warning(
+        "HiCache does not back up DSA index keys for this hybrid model when some "
+        "layers or MTP draft pools share top-k; host-tier hits may return wrong "
+        "output. Disable --enable-hierarchical-cache to avoid it."
+    )
+    return False
+
